details:
I really enjoy the custom emoji animations, but I wish there were a few more options. 

A simple track system could be the best way to go point to point

like in a very simple animator with a limited time and emojis you could use in the animation.

Some custom animation ideas

*fireball* one I would like the most is to summon an emoji like a magic fireball, the emoji appears in front of you getting bigger than it launches it will explode into small versions of its self on impact.

*jump scare* an emoji is placed somewhere in front of you while being invisible, then it randomly appears.

*Fairy dust, an emoji, flies around you and sprinkles smaller versions of itself on you.

*Paper airplane the emoji flies around the room like a paper airplane

*Windows 3.1 Screensaver - Flying Windows animation, lots of versions of your emoji flies towards you similar to the classic Windows logo screensaver

*bouncy ball your emoji bounces around like a super bouncy ball.

*You activated my trap card animation* a large version of your emoji appears in front of you, but it's one-sided, then it turns around to the quest showing your card.

Falling anvil animation, The emoji appears above someone then tries to fall on them, Mario thwomp style.

Fireworks animations for emojis would be amazing.

Thanks for reading, I know it's a bit silly, but I think having more options would be more enticing to use the emoji system or buy into vrchat plus.
title: *[More Emoji custom animations]* or simple animator for the emojis that follows a custom track.
